description: Engineering is about solving problems through design: investigating how a manufactured item works, the many kinds of engineers, visiting an engineer, designing an original device with the systems approach, hands-on projects, professional registration and ethics, and engineering careers.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. The 2026 update added requirement 9 on engineering careers. Requirement 8 was not visible in the excerpts and is not outlined yet.
